tools.name: gofetch_pricing
tools.description: Free. Returns gofetch's paid routes, prices, payTo, network, facilitator and the ways an agent can pay (x402 v2, USDC on Base). Call this first.

tools.name: gofetch_extract
tools.description: Reads static HTML only: it does not run JavaScript, so JS-rendered sites (most big retailers) and bot-protected sites fail with ok:false, error needs_js or blocked, and no charge. Paid: $0.005 USDC on Base via x402, charged only when ok is true. Always returns a fixed envelope ({url, title, markdown

findings.title: Tool description changed since last scan
findings.detail: Tool "gofetch_extract" changed its description with no version change. Silent description changes are how a trusted server turns malicious after review.
